objects.name: _sqliteai_vector
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE _sqliteai_vector (tblname TEXT, colname TEXT, key TEXT, value ANY, PRIMARY KEY(tblname, colname, key))

objects.name: workspaces
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "workspaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "logo_path" TEXT NULL, "owner_user_id" TEXT NULL, "secret_exclude_globs" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "review_concurrency" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3, "auto_publish_review" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("auto_publish_review" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "github_app_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "connect_mode" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inherit', "connect_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: users
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "handle" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "avatar_ref" TEXT NULL, "git_author_name" TEXT NULL, "git_author_email" TEXT NULL, "sso_subject" TEXT NULL, "sso_issuer" TEXT NULL, "deactivated_at" INTEGER NULL, "onboarding_finished_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "email_verified" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("email_verified" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: user_preferences
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "user_preferences" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "key"))

objects.name: paired_devices
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "paired_devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'web', "psk_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_fingerprint" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendingConfirm', "paired_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "last_seen_at" INTEGER NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: rss_feeds
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "rss_feeds" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "icon_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "user_agent" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "last_fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: rss_articles
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "rss_articles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "feed_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES rss_feeds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "guid" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "link" TEXT NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "image_url" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "author" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "published_at" INTEGER NULL, "saved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("saved" IN (0, 1)), "read" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("read" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: workers
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "workers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "caps_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "platform" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "credential_ref" TEXT NULL, "paired_device_id" TEXT NULL, "protocol_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'offline', "last_heartbeat_at" INTEGER NULL, "registered_by" TEXT NULL, "drained_at" INTEGER NULL, "revoked_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: jobs
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "jobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "spec_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "required_caps_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "preferred_caps_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', "worker_id" TEXT NULL, "pinned_worker_id" TEXT NULL, "lease_expires_at" INTEGER NULL, "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "submitted_by" TEXT NULL, "cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "max_attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "last_acked_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "result_json" TEXT NULL, "error" TEXT NULL, "agent_id" TEXT NULL, "conversation_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "leased_at" INTEGER NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: placement_log
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "placement_log" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "job_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "worker_id" TEXT NULL, "decision" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', "reason" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: workspace_routes
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "workspace_routes" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "key_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("kind", "key_hash"))

objects.name: server_meta
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "server_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"))

objects.name: server_settings
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "server_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("key"))

objects.name: sso_connections
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "sso_connections" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "issuer" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "client_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "groups_claim" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'groups', "idp_metadata_xml" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "sp_entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "email_attribute" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'email', "display_name_attribute" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'displayName', "groups_attribute" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'groups', "default_role" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member', "group_role_map" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "auto_member" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("auto_member" IN (0, 1)), "allow_jit" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("allow_jit" IN (0, 1)), "allow_idp_initiated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allow_idp_initiated" IN (0, 1)), "want_response_signed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("want_response_signed" IN (0, 1)), "clock_skew_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 90, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: idx_users_handle
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_handle ON users (handle)

objects.name: idx_rss_articles_feedId_guid
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_rss_articles_feedId_guid ON rss_articles (feed_id, guid)

objects.name: idx_workers_status
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_workers_status ON workers (status)

objects.name: idx_jobs_workspace_status
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_workspace_status ON jobs (workspace_id, status)

objects.name: idx_jobs_worker_status
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_worker_status ON jobs (worker_id, status)

objects.name: idx_jobs_lease_expiry
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_jobs_lease_expiry ON jobs (lease_expires_at)

objects.name: idx_placement_log_job
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_placement_log_job ON placement_log (job_id)

objects.name: idx_placement_log_workspace
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_placement_log_workspace ON placement_log (workspace_id)

objects.name: idx_users_sso_subject
objects.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_sso_subject ON users(sso_issuer, sso_subject) WHERE sso_issuer IS NOT NULL AND sso_subject IS NOT NULL

objects.name: managed_action_policies
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "managed_action_policies" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action_class" TEXT NULL, "command_prefix" TEXT NULL, "decision" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prompt', "enforcement" TEXT NULL, "constraint_json" TEXT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("action_class", "command_prefix"))

objects.name: invite_secure_routes
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE invite_secure_routes (route_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, code_hash TEXT NOT NULL, workspace_id TEXT NOT NULL)

objects.name: environment_slot_leases
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "environment_slot_leases" ("block" INTEGER NOT NULL, "first_port" INTEGER NOT NULL, "size" INTEGER NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "definition_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pool_key" TEXT NULL, "pool_slot" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("block"), UNIQUE ("pool_key", "pool_slot"), UNIQUE ("workspace_id", "space_id", "definition_id"))

objects.name: server_audit
objects.sql: CREATE TABLE "server_audit" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "ip" TEXT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "arg_names" TEXT NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"))

objects.name: idx_server_audit_created
objects.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_server_audit_created ON server_audit (created_at)
